title: The selected symmetric two-radius chart has unique second-order coefficients but one third-order freedom remains

pre_flight.question: K1738 fixes the leading chart velocity but leaves one second-order chart direction after beta=r_2=0; determine exactly whether the first later matched coefficient fixes that direction.
pre_flight.rederived_inputs: Use only the K1731 exact (p,a) chart, the K1727 isolated algebraic seed, and the K1736--K1738 matched scaled invariants. K1739 is a numerical consistency check and K1742 is not assumed.
pre_flight.problem_matched_gate: Expand the matched relative-Fisher objective through q^6 in the local invariant coordinates r=kappa_6/u^(3/2), x=h_8/u^2, y=h_10/u^(5/2), then transport the selected invariant coefficients through the nonzero chart Jacobian.
pre_flight.anti_overclaim: The gate can identify a finite jet only; it cannot certify a complete analytic branch, a finite-strength minimum, or a global two-radius optimizer.

coefficient_convention.chart_path: p(s)=p_0+P s+P_2 s^2+P_3 s^3+O(s^4), a(s)=a_0+A s+A_2 s^2+A_3 s^3+O(s^4), with s=sqrt(q); coefficients do not include factorials.

q6_selection.relevant_coefficient: After r_2=x_1=0, the q^6 coefficient contains gamma^2/120+4gamma/9+eta^2/5040+11eta/72+y_0 y_2/181440 plus terms independent of gamma and eta.
q6_selection.chart_chain_rule: In local (r,x) coordinates, y_2=y_x eta+(1/2)y_rr(35/3)^2, where y_x=(partial y/partial x)|_r at the seed.
q6_selection.coercivity: The gamma and eta Hessian entries are exactly 1/60 and 1/2520, so the selected invariant coefficients are strict local minima of the q^6 jet.

second_order_chart_solution.definitions: Let v_1=(P,A), v_2=(P_2,A_2), J=d(r,x)/d(p,a), and H_r,H_x be the chart Hessians at (p_0,a_0).
second_order_chart_solution.uniqueness: det J is nonzero at the isolated K1727 seed, so r_2=0 and x_2=eta fix v_2 uniquely.
second_order_chart_solution.certification: Exact rational interval arithmetic isolates u, encloses the chart square root, propagates two-variable second jets, proves det J excludes zero, and encloses both solved coefficients.

remaining_freedom.third_order_condition: The selected gamma=-80/3 condition is one affine equation in (P_3,A_3): grad(r).v_3+v_1^T H_r v_2+D^3r[v_1,v_1,v_1]/6=-80/3.
remaining_freedom.dimension: One third-order chart degree remains free because q^6 does not select x_3.
remaining_freedom.honest_boundary: K1743 proves a unique second-order chart jet and one selected third-order invariant combination, not a unique third-order chart jet or a complete local analytic branch.

post_flight.overclaim_check: Reject any promotion from the certified finite jet to complete-branch existence, finite-strength optimality, whole-chart uniqueness, or an all-seed lower bound.
post_flight.contrary_route_check: K1728's fixed-raw-radii motion remains a valid quartic-attaining representative but has the wrong K1738 leading tangent; K1739 remains numerical evidence and cannot replace this exact chart calculation.
post_flight.mistyping_check: The stored P_2 and A_2 multiply s^2 directly; reading them as second derivatives would introduce an erroneous factor of two.
post_flight.reproducibility_seam: Run tests/channel-swings/k1743_four_point_second_order_branch.py and its hostile probe; both reconstruct the algebraic seed and selected coefficients from the chart formulas.

scope_guard: This exact and interval-certified statement is local to the regular symmetric two-radius chart near the K1727 seed. It does not cover singular chart faces, remote branches, growing support, unrestricted stationary field laws, or a source-owned physical GU state.
